John Collins scored the Clippers' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 17 times in 56 starts, or 30% of the games they started. Ivica Zubac was next with 17. The Clippers made the game's first field goal in 47% of their 83 games and won 48% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
